trust_decision.summary: The browser UI decides whether the attacker-controllable post-login 'redirectTo' value (query param, or the query string stashed in sessionStorage across the OIDC round-trip) is a same-origin path before navigating to it; at the pinned commit no site checks it.

landing_point.why: The summary names the UI OIDC login flow and the redirectTo parameter; the only code that reads 'redirectTo' inside the OIDC component is the callback's window.location.replace(origin + redirectTo).

fix_sites.entry_point: shared helper isSafeRedirectPath added next to redirectToQueryParam (fix.diff:14-22); used by all three sinks
OIDC callback on /login (?code&state) after SSO; redirectTo comes from window.location.search saved to sessionStorage 'platform_redirect' at oidc-login.tsx:88
/login?redirectTo=... when already logged in, or right after admin password login sets the token (admin-login.tsx:21)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: ui/src/features/auth/token-renew.tsx:96 (separate post-auth redirect via react-router navigate in the refresh-token flow; also ui/src/pages/login/login.tsx:29 for admin/already-logged-in login)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the OIDC login callback; token renewal is a refresh flow, not login, and login.tsx uses react-router <Navigate>/navigate() which a solver may assume cannot leave the origin, so both look out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Deep-link return after login/renew must keep working: redirectTo is produced unencoded from window.location.pathname (e.g. /project/x/stage/y) and must still be honoured; an allowlist of route patterns or rejecting all redirects breaks it.

O6_input_shapes: value not starting with '/' (e.g. '@host' or '.host' concatenated to origin at oidc-login.tsx:155)
empty/null value falls back to home

O7_producer.where: redirectTo producers (protected-route.tsx:27, transport.ts:10-16, custom-fetch.ts:26-31) only copy window.location.pathname; the value crosses a sessionStorage boundary at oidc-login.tsx:88 -> :108 but the fix is sink-side and does not touch producers

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a failure branch that, instead of forwarding redirectTo to /login, navigates straight to it (window.location.replace(origin + redirectQuery))
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same component already forwards the raw redirectQuery three times (lines 90, 100, 110); a maintainer adding a 'retry/continue' path would plausibly reuse it directly.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: onSuccess handler that reads redirectTo from the URL and does window.location.assign itself rather than relying on login.tsx re-render
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: OIDC login already performs its own post-login redirect in-component (oidc-login.tsx:151-156); mirroring that in admin login is a natural refactor.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a logout/session-expired handler that honours a stored 'return URL' from sessionStorage/localStorage with full-page navigation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Interceptors already build redirect URLs here; a save/reload-type sibling (value stored, later consumed) fits the existing sessionStorage pattern at oidc-login.tsx:88.

O10_build.language: TypeScript (React 19-era SPA, react-router-dom 7.9.6) inside a Go monorepo
O10_build.project_tests: No tests for the auth area at the pinned commit (ui/src has 7 *.test.ts files, none under features/auth or pages/login); fix diff adds no tests. Hidden tests would need vitest + jsdom/RTL with window.location stubbing; isSafeRedirectPath-style logic is unit-testable.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a startsWith('/') check only in oidc-login.tsx's callback, leaving '//host' and '/\host' and the login.tsx / token-renew.tsx navigations open.

out_of_scope_notes: token-renew.tsx:90,100,110 and producers in transport.ts/custom-fetch.ts/protected-route.tsx interpolate values into the query string without encoding (parameter-injection hygiene, not a redirect sink itself).
No Go-side HTTP redirect sinks found (no http.Redirect / 3xx status use in *.go).
unverified: Whether react-router-dom 7.9.6 navigate()/<Navigate> with '//host' or 'https://host' actually leaves the origin (pushState cross-origin throws; behaviour of generatePath on such input not checked) - affects how exploitable login.tsx/token-renew.tsx are versus oidc-login.tsx.
All 5 fix commits carry the same patch (backports; login.tsx index differs: fix.diff:75 vs fix.diff:178), so 'many_fix_commits' is technical rather than substantive.
